title: Iran issues ‘most direct’ threat to US
description: Iran’s foreign minister issued the most direct threat yet on Wednesday against the United States after Tehran’s bloody crackdown on protesters, warning the Islamic Republic will be ‘firing back with everything we have if we come under renewed attack’.

title: Trump, Tehran vow war in response to assassination threats
description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — United States President Donald Trump reite­rated on Tuesday a warning that Iran would be wiped “off the face of this earth” if Tehran ever succeeded in assassinating him.
